build_policy: Strip PEP440 local +cpu/+cu build suffix for version identity; CPU profile must be CPU FP32, Kaggle requires CUDA T4. Import and real hardware preflight still mandatory.
installation: No automatic installation. Do not apply the stale root requirements-lock.txt. A reviewed matching private offline CUDA wheelhouse is a blocked prerequisite, not an available artifact. An alternate pinned stack requires an explicit revised contract, fresh local reference and separately registered output paths.
